---
title: Code block style, unknown key
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      shouldError: default
      printsMessage:
        level: ERROR
        regex: 'quarto-code-block-style: unknown key "fil"'
---

A misspelt key must stop the compile with a message that names it.

```{=typst}
#quarto-code-block-style.update(s => s + (fil: red))
```

x = 1
